'''Ed Rebman tatooine old skool mains (scum killa)''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Ed Rebman]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15565">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15565 tatooine old skool mains (scum killa)], DeckTech (Ed "eddiehectic" Rebman, 24 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15565/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15565/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ed Rebman]]
* '''Published:''' 24 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''tatooine old skool mains (scum killa)''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 TOSMSK Rebman LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' plays mains and SAC on tatooine, with some hidden surprises.  there is no strategy posted.
